name: Štúdiový produktový shot
summary: Hero produkt na čistom štúdiovom pozadí, mäkké difúzne svetlo, katalógová vernosť. Bezpečná voľba, keď má rozhodovať samotný produkt.
when_to_use: Produktové launche, jeden hero produkt, ponuky kde je vizuálna vernosť dôležitejšia než hravosť. Odporúčaný vzor: jeden hero produkt namiesto skupiny.
prompt_block: Render the image as a clean commercial studio product photograph. One hero product dominates the frame, shot at a slight three-quarter angle at eye level, tack sharp across the label. Lighting is large soft diffused key light from the upper left with a gentle fill from the right, producing a soft contact shadow directly under the product and a single subtle specular highlight along its edge. Background is a seamless studio sweep in one flat tone or a very soft vertical gradient, with a barely visible horizon. Colour rendering is neutral and true to the product. No props compete with the product; any supporting surface is plain and matte.
never: cluttered backgrounds or more than one competing product
hard flash shadows or coloured gel lighting
heavy post-processing, HDR look or oversaturation
visible studio equipment, tripods or reflections of lights
